EURO SPIN POLICY

Manual play: When a person wins a round, he/she restakes. When they lose, there is no restaking; they simply continue spinning.

Automatic play: If a person loses all the selected spins, they do not restake. If they win more than 3 spins, they restake.

Play guidance: Each round follows the selected play mode. Manual players may restake after a win, while a loss requires no restaking. In Automatic Play, players who lose all selected spins do not restake, while players who win more than 3 spins may continue with a new stake.
